Name: Fiddlehead Fern Season Change
Author: Suntooth
Description:
Ever accidentally missed the Fiddlehead Fern for the Community Center during fall and realised you'd have to wait a whole three seasons to get it if you didn't get lucky at the Travelling Cart? Make the wait a bit shorter and get it in Spring instead! This mod makes Fiddlehead Ferns spawn in the Secret Woods during Spring, as well as its default season of Summer.

In the future I'd like to make this mod fully customisable, where you can choose exactly which seasons to spawn the ferns in. I tried doing it for this version, but I got some weird bugs that I'm not sure how to fix. I've set the permissions so that others can improve this mod with my permission though, so feel free to try it out yourself! (Just ask me first :P )
